rank_rule: np.lexsort((source_row_id, -platt)); exact stored score equality; source ID ascending
capacity_rule: q = numpy.arange(501, dtype=float64)/10000; k = ceil(q*n); k=0 at q=0
aggregation: Rank each fitted model/seed separately; arithmetic mean of five recalls and TPs.
evidence_boundary: Descriptive completed-Test-window exact-K curves recomputed from saved Platt scores. They differ from Validation threshold transfer, impose no prospective decision rule, and contain no uncertainty intervals. The dense grid is evaluated directly; no interpolation, smoothing, jitter, model selection, or tie-rule alteration is applied.
